desc:
🛒 Can you get everything on Mom's list home before the MEGA SALE ends?

📝 Mom wakes you up with a shopping list a mile long and the car keys. 🚗 Squeeze through the craziest traffic jam in town, 👵 get past Grandma on her scooter and the store's security guard, then 🧺 fill your cart at Big Basket without toppling the tower. Survive the checkout line, pack the trunk and 🏠 race home to Mom!

🚨 Honk your way through the jam or call a VIP police escort. 😂 Throw Grandma off her scooter, 🔨 ban line-cutters and 😱 scare the whole server. 🎲 Every trip brings a brand-new list, and three trips unlock a 🎁 mystery chest!

👍 Like and favorite for new updates!
